deferred_by_owner_insertion.reason: Owner-directed ENV/CEW software integration insertion after MAL-10 and before ALP-01 so the completed content/API handoff cannot be silently skipped.

active_contract.rule: ALP-01 may implement only the authority crosswalk and deterministic taxonomy projection separating platform learning, campaign achievements, practice/training markers, project learning evidence, recognition records and mechanical reward references. No awarding, reward commit, hidden completion inference, persistence or ALP-02+ behavior is authorized.

boundaries: achievements are optional and not universal permission gates
unrelated capability cannot be granted by achievement implication
mechanical rewards commit through owning Reward/Progression/Reputation/Faction systems
platform learning and campaign achievements remain distinct
AI cannot silently award achievements or infer hidden completion
ALP-01 authority is limited to crosswalk/taxonomy classification and deterministic projection
no owner mutation, durable persistence or migration 0022
ALP-02+, VTI-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized
